title: Digital Marketer
description:
Attention: Talented marketers who want to feel appreciated, valued and part of something worthwhile!

Warning! This job advert isn't like others you've seen and there's a good reason for that.

I'll get to it shortly

Whether you're stuck, stagnating or just starting out, getting a rewarding job in the digital marketing industry isn't always easy.

In fact, since the explosion of AI, just knowing how to DO online marketing is no longer enough.

Being part of a team that can 'pinpoint' exactly how to make marketing work and achieve jaw-dropping results is the best way to fulfil your potential, accelerate your marketing career and love the job you do each day.

If you're the kind of online marketer who can't rest until your copy is compelling, your campaigns are neatly named and even your wardrobe is ordered by the colours of the electromagnetic spectrum (ok, perhaps a little too far!).

If you set goals, have a thirst for knowledge, do what you say, when you say then we like the cut of your jib!

Your day-to-day activities will include:
- Generating and analysing monthly marketing reports
- Hosting customer monthly and quarterly marketing meetings
- Communicating directly with customers
- Completing all monthly marketing work for each of your customers
- Planning and managing monthly SEO work
- Planning and creating blog posts and content ideas
- Google Ads management and optimisation
- Social media management and content creation
- Facebook Ads management and optimisation
- Bing Ads management and optimisation
- Planning and management of customer monthly offer campaigns
- Scheduling and managing daily and weekly workflows
- Weekly performance reporting
- Attending daily and weekly team meetings
- Upselling for growing marketing campaigns

You'll get the keys to our Pandora's box of proven marketing tools, the freedom to use them, and the backing to deliver results most marketers only dream about.

Here's What To Do Next

Scroll to the top of this advert and click on the pink 'Apply now' button to be taken to our special page, which has all the details.

Whenever we do this, we get a lot of interest as you might expect.

Don't put this off, take the easy next step towards the marketing career you deserve and apply for your 'work from home' internet marketing job by 5pm on Thursday 26 November 2026.

P.S Just to make sure you have the right skills

This role is perfect for anyone who is or is looking to progress as a digital marketer, online marketer, internet marketer, social media marketer, junior marketer, marketing assistant, marketing coordinator, marketing executive, marketing manager or anyone who has an eye for creating marketing that works.

ALSO, you don't need any past work experience or qualifications, just passion and a good eye for marketing and business growth.

Easily apply for this exciting digital marketing position (no past job experience or qualifications needed) by clicking the pink 'Apply now' button.

Stay Awesome.

title: Growth Marketing Executive
description:
An opportunity for a commercially minded B2 B marketer to own marketing and lead generation at a growing food ingredients business. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where HubSpot and AI tools sit at the centre of how you work, turning interest into qualified leads for the sales team.

Growth Marketing Executive

Location: Coalville
- £30,000 - £35,000 per annum + Excellent Benefits
- Full-time, Permanent
- Hours: 40 hours per week (30 minutes unpaid lunch)

Please note: you must be authorised to work in the UK.

About Us

The BakeRite Company is an experienced importer, stockist and distributor of healthy, natural and free-from ingredients for the specialist bakery and food and drink markets. We are a stable, family-owned business with open communication, accessible leadership and a collaborative team culture.

About the Role

Reporting to the Sales & Marketing Manager, you will drive BakeRite's marketing and lead generation, working closely with Sales, NPD and senior management. The aim is a strong, consistent BakeRite brand and a steady flow of the right leads, with marketing measured by the results it delivers. This role is office-based in Coalville.

Key responsibilities
- Plan and deliver marketing campaigns on time and within budget, and act as guardian of the BakeRite brand
- Build target account lists in HubSpot, set up lead scoring and routing, and qualify website enquiries before handing them to Sales
- Create landing pages, gated content and targeted email campaigns, and lead our move of email marketing into HubSpot
- Manage the website, SEO and LinkedIn, including a weekly post and a monthly market update
- Use Claude and other AI tools daily to build repeatable workflows that research markets and accounts, draft content and automate routine tasks
- Keep HubSpot data clean and report monthly on leads, conversion and campaign results
- Produce sales collateral, including the company presentation, product sheets and the annual brochure and catalogue, and organise trade shows, client visits and sample packs

About You

Skills and experience
- 2-3 years' B2 B marketing experience
- Hands-on HubSpot (or similar CRM and email platform) experience
- Practical use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot at work, with examples you can show us
- Website CMS, SEO and LinkedIn experience, with working knowledge of UK GDPR and PECR as they apply to marketing
- Excellent written English, with strong copywriting and proofreading skills
- Strong analytical skills and confidence with data, Excel and reporting
- Well organised, with experience planning events, visits or similar logistics

Desirable
- Food, ingredients, bakery, FMCG or B2 B manufacturing experience
- HubSpot Academy certifications
- Experience building AI-driven workflows (Claude projects and skills, Zapier, Make)
- Canva and/or Adobe skills, plus photography and video
- A marketing degree or CIM qualification
- Full UK driving licence

Benefits
- Competitive remuneration package, enhanced pension contributions and enhanced sick pay scheme
- 20 days holiday plus your birthday off, plus bank holidays (29 days per annum)
- Additional holiday entitlement for long service
- Access to company-funded private medical insurance for you and your family
- Free breakfast and lunch, with soft drinks, tea and coffee available all day
- Funded opportunities for ongoing training and professional development
- Modern Coalville office with free on-site parking and EV charging

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Growth Marketing Executive position based in Coalville, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Growth Marketing Executive, Marketing Executive, B2 B Marketing Executive, Digital Marketing Executive, Lead Generation Executive, Content Marketing Executive, Marketing Officer or Marketing Coordinator.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
As a Marketing Manager in Leicester, you will lead day-to-day marketing activity for an FMCG business, helping to keep campaigns clear, relevant and well organised. You will work across the Marketing & Agency department to bring plans together and support strong brand presence in the market.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the FMCG sector in Leicester.

Description
- Plan and deliver marketing activity that supports brand awareness and commercial priorities.
- Develop clear campaign briefs and coordinate activity with agency partners.
- Manage marketing plans, timelines and budgets to keep work on track.
- Work with internal teams to ensure marketing activity reflects business priorities.
- Review campaign performance and use findings to improve future activity.
- Maintain consistent brand messaging across marketing materials and channels.
- Coordinate the creation of campaign assets, ensuring they are ready for use on time.
- Keep stakeholders updated on marketing plans, delivery progress and results.

Profile

A successful 'Marketing Manager' should have:
- Experience planning and delivering marketing campaigns.
- Experience working with agencies and managing campaign briefs.
- Knowledge of brand marketing within an FMCG setting.
- Ability to manage marketing plans, budgets and deadlines.
- Experience reviewing campaign performance and using data to guide decisions.
- Ability to produce clear marketing communications and maintain brand consistency.

Job Offer
- Permanent Marketing Manager position based in Leicester.
- Salary of 40,000 to 45,000, dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Performance Manager

Hybrid, Loughborough,

09:00 - 17:00, Monday to Friday

Up to £40,000

Macildowie are working with this client based in Loughborough, a rapidly growing, commercially focused digital marketing agency specialising in performance marketing, SEO, Paid Media and integrated marketing solutions.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Digital Performance Manager to take ownership of performance across a diverse client portfolio, combining strategic oversight with hands-on Paid Media delivery.

If you're an experienced digital marketing professional who enjoys analysing performance, challenging strategy, developing specialists and delivering measurable commercial results, this could be an excellent next step.

The Role

Working closely with senior leadership, account teams and channel specialists, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring SEO and Paid Media activity consistently delivers against client objectives.

You'll provide strategic direction, maintain high reporting standards and support client relationships, while retaining the opportunity to manage and optimise Paid Media campaigns directly.

Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee SEO and Paid Media performance across multiple client accounts.
- Review and challenge channel strategies to ensure activity supports commercial objectives.
- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement clear optimisation and recovery plans.
- Monitor performance KPIs, campaign budgets, account health and emerging risks.
- Act as a senior point of contact for clients, leading performance reviews and strategic discussions.
- Support account teams with performance-related client concerns and escalations.
- Review client reports, ensuring accuracy, actionable insights and clear recommendations.
- Develop and maintain quality assurance standards across digital performance delivery.
- Mentor and support SEO and Paid Media specialists, with the opportunity to develop formal line management responsibilities.
- Oversee external digital marketing resources and manage workload priorities.
- Plan, launch, manage and optimise Paid Media campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and other relevant platforms.
- Review account structures, targeting, budgets, conversion performance and campaign efficiency.
- Support campaign troubleshooting, testing and optimisation where additional delivery expertise is required.

About You

We're looking for a commercially minded digital performance specialist who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on campaign delivery.

Essential Experience:
- Strong digital performance marketing experience gained within an agency environment.
- Significant hands-on Paid Media experience, particularly across Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- A strong strategic understanding of SEO and how it contributes to wider marketing performance.
- Experience managing multiple client accounts and campaign budgets.
- Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into commercial recommendations.
- Experience reviewing and developing digital marketing strategies.
- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or managing other team members.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive, collaborative approach to improving performance and maintaining high standards.

Desirable Experience:
- Previous experience as a Digital Performance Manager, Senior Paid Media Manager or similar.
- Experience with Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads or TikTok Ads.
- Knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and conversion tracking.
- Experience working across both B2 B and B2 C campaigns.
- Exposure to ecommerce and lead generation accounts.
- Experience managing external specialists or outsourced resources.
- Understanding of attribution, analytics and multi-channel reporting.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £35,000-£40,000 per annum.
- Company pension.
- Free on-site parking.
- Potential home-working flexibility, subject to confirmation.
- The opportunity to influence digital performance strategy across a growing client portfolio.
- Exposure to varied clients, industries and performance marketing challenges.
- The chance to mentor and develop channel specialists.
- A key role in shaping the future of a growing digital marketing function.
- A collaborative and commercially focused agency environment.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Paid Media professional with a strong understanding of SEO, a passion for performance and the confidence to lead strategic client conversations, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Macildowie for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

description:
Job Description: Product Content Specialist

Location: Remote
Contract: Temporary, initially 6 months, with the possibility of extension
Pay: £16.11 per hour
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 09 00

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organised Product Content Specialist to support the creation and maintenance of product information across our European e-commerce platforms. The role involves gathering product data from suppliers, improving product descriptions and images, and ensuring all content meets company standards and brand guidelines.

The ideal candidate will have strong written communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Key Responsibilities
- Liaise with suppliers to obtain product specifications, technical information and supporting data.
- Create, review and update product descriptions to ensure information is accurate, clear and consistent.
- Upload and maintain product information using internal content management systems.
- Ensure published content follows company procedures, formatting requirements and brand guidelines.
- Review existing product pages and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Work with internal teams, including IT and business stakeholders, to coordinate content updates and meet deadlines.
- Manage competing priorities and deliver work within agreed timescales.

Qualifications and Requirements
- Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel is essential, including the ability to manage, organise and analyse large datasets accurately.
- A degree in Technical Writing, a scientific discipline or a related subject is desirable but not essential.
- Strong written English, with excellent spelling, grammar and proofreading skills.
- Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate product information.

Skills and Experience
- Ideally, 1 3 years of experience creating or maintaining digital content within a content management system.
- Good understanding of scientific terminology, technical product information and industry abbreviations.
- Knowledge of HTML formatting would be an advantage.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including providing clear updates on progress.
- A proactive and adaptable approach to changing priorities and urgent requests.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
